question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing sweeper, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing right midfielder, and Eve is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) sweeper
(C) benchwarmer
(D) right midfielder
(E) right winger
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve, in that order.
Initial: fullback | sweeper | benchwarmer | right midfielder | right winger
1. Dave ↔ Eve: fullback | sweeper | benchwarmer | right winger | right midfielder
2. Dave ↔ Alice: right winger | sweeper | benchwarmer | fullback | right midfielder
3. Bob ↔ Claire: right winger | benchwarmer | sweeper | fullback | right midfielder
4. Dave ↔ Alice: fullback | benchwarmer | sweeper | right winger | right midfielder
5. Bob ↔ Eve: fullback | right midfielder | sweeper | right winger | benchwarmer
Dave is playing right winger, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
